question: Is the nightly export job safe to turn back on?
finding: Yes. The failure was a single expired credential, rotated on Sep 3; the job has run clean in a sandbox for three nights since.

blocks.headline: Turn the nightly export back on?
blocks.summary: Re-enable the production schedule. Nothing else changes.
blocks.scope: Flip the production cron entry from disabled to enabled. No code or credential changes.
